753b4fda6c27137e.reason: yindex serve listens in-cluster only (ClusterIP Service); TLS is terminated at the Envoy Gateway, which routes the three CompactTxStreamer methods to it (templates/gateway/routes.yaml). It serves public chain data and holds no secret.

rule_paths.reason: Operator scripts run by hand on a developer machine against a kind cluster (kubectl/ycash-cli with argv lists, no shell, arguments from the script's own config).
Operator scripts run by hand against a kind cluster; the URL is the node RPC endpoint from the script's own config, never untrusted input.

contrib/secops/code-scanning-triage.py runs `gh api` with an argv list (no shell) built from constants, the alert number from the API and the workflow-supplied repository name; it runs only in .github/workflows/code-scanning.yml with that job's own token. A subprocess call anywhere else is still reported.

bundles/prefix/tests/fake_docker.py is the test double for `docker` in the run-local.sh tests: it starts sys.executable -I with argv lists (no shell) on this repository's own test scripts and harvest.py, with arguments from run-local.sh under test. It runs only inside `make prefix-test`, never in a deployment. A subprocess call anywhere else is still reported.
